mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, order_no, refund_no, refund_amount, product_refund_amount, freight_refund_amount, refund_quantity, clawback_bonus, reason, operator_id, operator_name, refund_time, create_time FROM dms_finance_refund WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_order scoped_order WHERE scoped_order.id = dms_finance_refund.order_id AND COALESCE(scoped_order.tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId}) ORDER BY refund_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(refund_amount), 0) FROM dms_finance_refund WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_order scoped_order WHERE scoped_order.id = dms_finance_refund.order_id AND COALESCE(scoped_order.tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId})
